About Poiya Healthcare

A Trusted Leader in Healthcare Industry

What began in 2008 as Digital Photo Chemistry under Mr. Ramkumarr Dubey has grown into Poiya Healthcare(India) Pvt. Ltd. — a trusted supplier of diagnostic imaging, Nephrology, Pathology, Oncology and other medical equipments to hospitals and diagnostic centres nationwide. Headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, we continue to serve customers across India with quality products and dependable services.

  • ✓Digital Radiography (DR) & Computed Radiography (CR) Systems
  • ✓X-Ray Machines, C-Arm & Cath Lab Systems
  • ✓CT Scan & MRI Systems
  • ✓Dialysis Machines & Consumables
  • ✓Pathology & Oncology Equipment
  • ✓Nationwide AMC, Installation & Technical Support
